question.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

exchange.sent: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

conversation.title: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability…

messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

| Tester type | Wi-Fi 7/8 technology change | Required measurement capability impact | RAW evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 7 requires WLAN-device RF transmitter and receiver measurements under real-world signaling conditions. | The tester must support signaling-mode RF TX/RX measurement under real-world conditions. | [26], [28] |
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 7 makes MLO a key feature. | The tester must provide multiple RF chains for MLO testing. | [26], [28] |
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E testing. | The tester must cover multi-antenna, 6 GHz discovery, coexistence, and end-to-end test capabilities. | [28] |
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 7 testing benefits from support for multiple radio technologies and embedded IP test capabilities. | The tester should support multi-radio test scenarios and IP-layer/application-related validation. | [26], [28] |
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 8 retains Wi-Fi 7 physical-layer parameters such as frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM, and MLO. | The tester must preserve Wi-Fi 7-class RF bandwidth, modulation, frequency-range, and MLO measurement capability for Wi-Fi 8. | [27] |
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 8 introduces new PHY and MAC technologies to meet UHR goals. | The tester needs enhanced Wi-Fi 8 capability to handle new testing hurdles from those PHY/MAC changes. | [27] |
| Signaling tester | Wi-Fi 8 testing is described as validating a prototype device and showcasing physical-layer features unique to Wi-Fi 8. | The tester must be able to validate prototype Wi-Fi 8 devices and exercise Wi-Fi 8-unique PHY features. | [25] |
【推論】Because Wi-Fi 8 retains MLO and Wi-Fi 7 requires multiple RF chains for MLO, Wi-Fi 8 signaling testers should also maintain multiple-RF-chain capability. [26], [27]
